description: A non-ARQ U_PDU from a node with a six-nibble address to a one-nibble individual address goes out with the address size the source needs.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 0 it sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST: priority 0, SAP 5 at 0.0.0.7, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (TTD 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), U_PDU "hello", no confirmation, so no SIS output (A-0095). This node's own address is 0.200.1.0, which needs six nibbles; the destination 0.0.0.7 (GROUP ADDRESS 0, C-0340) alone needs one. There is no address size setting: the sender picks, per D_PDU, the smallest whole number of nibbles that holds both the destination and the source, and m is that number (C-0133, C-0130), so here the source sets m = 6 and the destination is widened with leading zeros to the same length. The trailing zero byte of the source is sent (C-0131). With m even each address takes three whole bytes (C-0117): the field is 00 00 07 c8 01 00, destination first (C-0115, C-0116, C-0127). The D_PDU is type 7 (C-0323, C-0575), EOW 0 EMPTY (C-0398), C_PDU ID 0, offset 0, the whole 11-byte DATA C_PDU (DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD, B-0297) as its one segment, 38 bytes in all, in block 0 of a one-block burst (256-byte blocks, preamble 600, flush 150, duration 5550 ms), so EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). Contention: LBT 30000 (DCD-determined idle, K-0070), slot 15 from seed 0, 45000 ms (K-0080). This case was added in review of M0LTE/M0LTE.S5066#35, so that a source wider than the destination is covered too.
